eps.t: Successor to the Divine Fist of the North Star: Kasumi Kenshiro
eps.ov: The year is 193X. The world is in a terrible conflict and it seems that only able to stop it is the 62nd successor of the Divine Fist of the North Star, Kasumi Kenshiro
Kenshiro confronts Fei-yan, believing it was him who killed Guise, but he will soon discover that it is far from the truth
Fei-yan is aware that he has little time left to live, so he will do whatever it takes to ensure Erika's wellness

eps.t: Origin of the Divine Fist of the North Star
eps.ov: The problem of Fei-yan and Erika seems to be solved by now, but it has not yet been clarified who killed Guise, so they will have to look for more evidence
Fei-yan has found the man responsible for the murder of Guise. The problem is that it is a deadly rival who dominates a deadly fighting style.
Guise's assassin threatens the life of Fei-yan, but fortunately Kenshiro appears to stop the murder of his friend and face a tough rival
Yasaka is determined to put an end to everything that matters to the Fist of the North Star, but in exchange for that he will discover a vital aspect about his past and his great resentment.
Finally Yasaka has discovered the serious mistake he has made for a long time. Yet, that will not stop Kenshiro and him from measuring their strength to end it all.

"Glowing fists...?" Based on the burn marks left on Guise's body, Kenshiro, Ye, Zi-Ying, and Yasaka arrive at one answer when discussing who killed him. On a hill near the church, Erika is praying over Fei-Yan's grave. Yasaka approaches to ask for her forgiveness. When she sees the glowing jewels dangling around his neck, she reveals their surprising past. Meanwhile, Kenshiro's surroundings suddenly grow dark with the color of the Nahash people...
